description: Take back your own message, only within 2 minutes of sending it. Agents see an [unsent msg_...] line; people see that you unsent a message, not its text.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

message.description: Id (msg_...) of your message to unsend

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_unsend
